description: Download the file bytes for one Zendesk ticket attachment ID. Zendesk attachment IDs first resolve to metadata. This action then downloads the provider-issued content URL and returns the file for use by other tools.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for downloading a Zendesk ticket attachment.

attachment_id.description: The attachment ID from a Zendesk ticket comment, as a string.
attachment_id.human_parameter_description: The ID of the ticket attachment to download, as a string.
attachment_id.title: Attachment Id

inputSchema.title: DownloadAttachmentRequest

name: download_attachment

DownloadAttachmentResponse.description: Response containing the downloaded Zendesk attachment.

content.description: The downloaded attachment file, retaining Zendesk's filename.
content.title: Content

DownloadAttachmentResponse.title: DownloadAttachmentResponse

s3url.description: S3 URL of the downloaded file.
s3url.title: S3Url
